title: Featured contributor at Dublin Tech Week
summary: Spoke on “Research to Startup” innovation pathways alongside European Commission and Parliament liaison offices in Ireland.
body: Yao was a featured contributor at Dublin Tech Week's European Innovation Policy Event, speaking on “Research to Startup” innovation pathways alongside European Commission and Parliament liaison offices in Ireland.

title: Invited as Associate Editor for ECIS 2026
summary: Overseeing peer review and meta-review decisions for the European Conference on Information Systems.
body: Yao was invited to serve as Associate Editor for the European Conference on Information Systems (ECIS) 2026, overseeing peer review processes, recruiting reviewers, and synthesising evaluations into meta-review decisions.

title: Paper accepted at BERA ECR Journey
summary: New research accepted for presentation at the BERA Early Career Researcher event.
body: New research was accepted for presentation at the BERA Early Career Researcher (ECR) Journey event.

title: Published in the WHO Bulletin
summary: “Towards an inclusive digital health ecosystem” appeared in the Bulletin of the World Health Organization.
body: Yao's paper, “Towards an inclusive digital health ecosystem,” was published in the Bulletin of the World Health Organization (103(2):170-173), contributing to global conversations around digital health equity.

title: AI Contextual Framework presented at AAAI/ACM AIES
summary: A zoning approach to AI governance, reframing oversight as well-being efficacy.
body: Yao presented “AI Contextual Framework: A Zoning Approach” at the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES) 2025 — a zoning approach to AI governance that reframes human oversight as a dimension of well-being efficacy rather than compliance.

title: Poster presentation at ELLIS UnConference EurIPS
summary: Presented research on contextual well-being and AI-mediated environments.
body: Yao presented a poster on contextual well-being and AI-mediated environments at the ELLIS UnConference, held alongside EurIPS.

title: Awarded the RCSI & UCD Campus Scholarship
summary: Supporting One Health field training as part of the PhD programme.
body: Yao was awarded the RCSI & University College Dublin Campus Scholarship, supporting One Health field training as part of her PhD programme.

title: Awarded the Clifford C. Clogg Scholarship
summary: Supporting attendance at the ICPSR Summer Program, University of Michigan.
body: Yao was awarded the Clifford C. Clogg Scholarship, supporting attendance at the ICPSR Summer Program at the University of Michigan.

title: Organised and spoke at Nelson Mandela Anti-Racism Week
summary: Organiser and invited panellist for an open talk as part of Anti-Racism Week.
body: Yao organised and served as an invited panellist for an open talk as part of Nelson Mandela Anti-Racism Week.

title: Secured Nelson Mandela EDI Project Fund
summary: Funding secured for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) initiatives.
body: Yao secured funding through the Nelson Mandela EDI (Equality, Diversity and Inclusion) Project Fund to support Anti-Racism initiatives.

title: Paper presentation at ECER Emerging Researchers' Conference
summary: Presented research at the European Conference on Educational Research's Emerging Researchers' Conference (ERC).
body: Yao presented research at the Emerging Researchers' Conference (ERC), part of the European Conference on Educational Research (ECER).

title: Awarded the International Merit Scholarship
summary: Four-year funding awarded by the University of Galway.
body: Yao was awarded the International Merit Scholarship, providing four-year funding from the University of Galway.
